messages.subject: Quartz - where we are on limitations
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

State of play on Quartz before the next turn:
- Cap: they've signalled the deal is done at 10% of consideration. Eleanor has instructions from Ardenfield to accept 10% provided Northstar CoC and the HMRC R&D enquiry are fully disclosed - which Ashworth Quinn have now agreed.
- Warranty period 18 months / tax 7 years - agreed.
- Non-compete 24 months - agreed.

I'll prepare v3 dropping the cap to 10% (£3,875,000) and adding a fraud/wilful carve-out. Elena to update the disclosure letter index. Tom to sense-check the EMI exercise mechanics.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
